# Rights and provenance

This repository is public, and **all rights are reserved** ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). The game, its art, story, characters, world, documents and tools belong to the Poncho Goblins team (Vatsal, Lex and Alexander Rudaev). You may read them here, but not copy, reuse or publish them without our written permission. The team agreed to publish the repository on 25 Oct 2026.

**Our art** (`art/`) is generated by the scripts in `scripts/` from our own photos and approved art. Every image's prompt and inputs are in its config (`art/**/*.json`) and on its Markdown page. The source photos and recordings belong to the team and are kept in the team Drive, outside Git.

**THD material.** The hero's poncho crest, the Deggster mascot (Dexter), the Fast Forest car (Jenny), campus buildings and lab robots are affectionate references for a THD game jam. The reference photos for the mascot plush and costume (THD Campus Store, webshop.th-deg.de; th-deg.de) and for Jenny (Fast Forest e.V., fast-forest.de) are public photos, used as drawing references only and not committed. Before any public release outside the jam, ask THD for permission to use the mascot and the logo, and Fast Forest for Jenny.

**Reference media** (`references/games/`, `references/animation/`) – screenshots, GIFs and trailer frames – stays the copyright of its developers, publishers and creators. It is quoted for research: each picture sits in a written study of the mechanics and looks we learn from, with its source and credit next to it. It is not part of the game, is never shipped, and is not covered by our [LICENSE](LICENSE). If you own any of it and want it removed, open an issue and we will take it down. The playground trailer frames are by Rodrigo Goulão de Sousa (music and sound: Jérémy Ben Ammar).

**Fiction.** The quantum experiment, the anomalies and every character's behaviour are invented. No real person, professor or department is depicted, and private portraits are not in this repository. The campus collages (`references/campus/`) are made from photos taken by, or with the consent of, the people in them.

**Audio and fonts** used in the build must be CC0 or similarly licensed; list each one here when it's added.
